custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active part, part A.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425595-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425595-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • Theme: click your avatar (the AS circle) at the top right; Light and Dark are at the bottom of its menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • Bulk mode turns on.

Step 3:

  • In the light theme the bar is near-black, the count 1 is white, the word "selected" is light grey, and the bar's corners are rounded.
  • Side by side with design board 4.3 at 100% zoom, the bar's colour and corner rounding match the board (the PRD gives #121926 and 8 pixels).

Step 4:

  • The avatar menu opens with the theme choices.

Step 5:

  • In the dark theme the bar is white and its text is dark, and its corners are still rounded.

Step 6:

  • The avatar menu opens.

Step 7:

  • The bar is near-black again.

Step 8:

  • Bulk mode ends.
